decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The changelog line [ev-ee73106833c6] is vague by itself, but the linked PR [ev-236b8bfb4fb6] spells out the change, and the PR is labelled breaking. Before, Traefik always auto-detected the Content-Type header. Now auto-detection is off by default and only runs when the `ContentType` middleware is applied. The PR also removes that middleware's `autoDetect` option. That is enough to write the applicability condition: an environment is exposed if it routes HTTP traffic through routers without a `ContentType` middleware and relied on the old auto-detection, or if its dynamic configuration sets `contentType.autoDetect`. The changed files [ev-ca618736f91c] show the option was removed from the dynamic-configuration references and covered in the v2-to-v3 migration guide. Note that the evidence does not say what happens to a configuration that still sets `autoDetect`: it could be rejected or ignored.
